purpose_context: Two scheduled Felix crons fail silently by improvising fragile operations through an LLM. This mission mechanizes their deterministic work into tested helpers and a non-LLM driver, and makes their Vikunja scope selection config-driven so the upcoming Vikunja reorganization (#714) is a config change, not code. It is a stability precondition before expanding Felix's executive-assistant capabilities.
purpose_tldr: Make Felix's daily escalation and weekly habit-report crons run deterministically and deliver reliably, ending silent failures.
